## Why this fits the project

<!-- breachsafe-ux is a config-driven single-tool UX host. Adding support for a
     tool should be a YAML descriptor, not new UI code. Read the ADRs under
     docs/adr/ (especially the host/descriptor boundary) before filing.

     IN scope: the host engine (renderer, runner, external validation, the
     three-state verdict), the descriptor format, and shared UX.

     OUT of scope: tool-specific logic that belongs inside a wrapped tool, or
     work that breaks the host/descriptor boundary.

     If your request is out of scope, open it anyway if you have a strong case
     for changing scope. -->
